name: Bollinger Breakout
description: Breakout strategy using Bollinger Bands. Buys when price breaks above upper band, sells short when price breaks below lower band. Exits at the middle SMA line.

signals.entry_long: Close crosses above upper Bollinger Band
signals.exit_long: Close crosses back below middle Bollinger Band
signals.entry_short: Close crosses below lower Bollinger Band
signals.exit_short: Close crosses back above middle Bollinger Band
